degree.text: Degree Awarded Bachelor Degree of Medicine

description.text: Why Study MBBS in Nankai University -- A Pioneer in International Education -- Located in Tianjin, just 30 minutes to Beijing -- Validated and quality-assured by the World Health Organisation Laboratory facilities at Nankai University Nankai University laboratories allow the delivery of a wide range of practical classes in the biological sciences; complementing the information derived from other teaching sessions, as well as giving direct experience of experimental and diagnostic techniques. Main Courses Regional Anatomy, Histology & Embryology, Medical Biochemistry, Cell Biology,Innovation Research & Training, Pathology, Pharmacology, Diagnostics, Epidemiology, Medical Ethnics, Operative Surgery, Paediatrics, Infectious Diseases etc. Study Duration 6 years; 40 hour learning week with 20 hours contact teaching per week Study Location Years 1 - 4: Nankai University, Tianjin Years 5 - 6: Clinical placement in a leading Chinese hospital Degree Awarded Bachelor Degree of Medicine

duration.text: The MBBS at Nankai University is a 6 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 185 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 8888 USD/per year ￥ 64000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. 6. Curriculum Vitae 7. Personal Statement Including personal experience,study motivation, study plan and etc. 8. Certificate of Employment(If Applicable) Any one with working experience must submit employment certificate.

requirements.text: 1. A-level (or equivalent) grades BBB to include Biology and Chemistry 2. IELTS 5.5 or equivalent or GCSE/iGCSE English grade B 3. No Chinese-citizen with foreign passport 4. With a good health and the age above 18.
